structure: The GB notification service prototype (GOV.UK Prototype Kit, Nunjucks views, one Express router) at ~/git/defra/defra-design/GB-notification-service, commit c2078fb (the checkout's HEAD is c2078fb, so files can be read in place; use git show c2078fb:<path> if it has moved). The previous extract was taken at 04a073b; 70 commits since then add a gross weight page, a delete-document page, an amend confirmation page, a postcode find-address journey, germinal templates, per-commodity identification fields, a generated full commodity list and dashboard filter and status changes, and grow app/routes.js from 13,114 to 15,341 lines. Design Release 2.1 is not a separate app: app/lib/design-release-2.1-version.js (42 lines) calls app/lib/version-mount.js (365 lines), which copies every route in app/routes.js under /design-release-2.1, keeps a separate session nest (_designRelease21, flag _isDesignRelease21Version), prefixes journey paths in redirects and render data, sets service-navigation hrefs, and renders app/views/design-release-2.1/<view>.html where one exists, otherwise the root view. DR2.1 also sets isDesignRelease2Version. Handlers branch on isDesignRelease21SessionData, hasJourneyUpdates (true for DR2.1, Testing 3 and Testing 4), isDesignRelease21OnlySessionData (DR2.1 without the Testing flags) and isRound2TestingSessionData (Testing 3 and 4 only, so branches under it do not apply to DR2.1). app/routes.js: lines 1-96 are requires and constants, lines 97-12688 are about 600 helper functions (session, validation, view models, render functions), lines 12689-15139 are about 120 route handlers including the generated consignment-address section routes, lines 15140-15331 are the sign-in redirect and the postcode find-address spike (mountFindAddress, mounted for the address book and each selectable consignment section), and lines 15332-15341 mount the versions. Views in scope: the 39 DR2.1 overrides in app/views/design-release-2.1/ (about 5,000 lines), the 19 DR2.1 partials in app/views/partials/design-release-2.1/ (about 1,100 lines), the root views DR2.1 falls back on (index, address-book, address-book-add, address-book-add-usage, address-book-lookup, address-book-view, find-address, find-address-select, postcode-lookup; about 1,300 lines), the root partials the DR2.1 pages include or routes.js renders (notification-status, region-of-origin-code-input, arrival-date-picker, cph-number-input, permanent-address-new-address-fields, the four reason-for-import selects, the transporter fields and banner, address-book-manual-address-fields), and layouts/main.html and layouts/journey.html (which now includes partials/design-release-2.1/cancel-amend-modal.html). app/data/ holds 35 list files (about 4,200 lines) plus app/data/generated/. Cut into 17 parts by what a user sees, keeping the previous extract's 16 themes and numbering so its claims fall to the same part: the shell and journey control, then the journey in page order (start, consignment and gross weight, reason, identification, arrival and transit, transporter, roles and addresses, CPH and permanent address, documents, review and submit), then notification hub with amend and copy, dashboard, templates, the address book in two parts, and a new part 17 for the postcode find-address pages. routes.js is too big for one agent, so each part reads the routes.js line ranges that hold its pages' helpers, render functions and handlers; the ranges tile lines 1-15341 with no gaps or overlaps, and a view, partial or data file shared by two parts is read by both but claimed only for the pages the part names. Left out by scope: app/views/intro/ and intro/routes.js; app/views/testing/, testing3/, testing4/ and their partials folders, and app/lib/testing-version.js, testing3-version.js and testing4-version.js (the design-release-2 folders no longer exist at this commit); and the root journey views DR2.1 overrides, including the unused root review-summary-card, review-summary-row, animal-identification-saved-animals and dashboard-date-range-input partials. Also left out: app/assets/ (client-side JavaScript, Sass and assets/data/common-names-live.json, not named by the scope; the rendered traces source covers client behaviour); app/data/generated/commodities-live.json (8,259 lines of generated catalogue, read through commodities.js and described by generated/README.md; the commodity catalogue waits on MDM and app/data is no evidence for data) and app/data/generated/postcode-addresses/ (one generated Companies House fixture per postcode district); and three files nothing in scope reads (app/data/package-types.js, app/data/place-of-origin-addresses.js, used only by intro/routes.js, and app/views/testing*/cancel-amend-notification.html, which only Testing 3 and 4 render).
